title: Use conditional visibility in the updated Word add-in

en.title: Use conditional visibility in the updated Word add-in
en.summary: Design document reports layouts with conditional visibility using the new HideIf logic control in the Word add-in. The control can use boolean fields in the dataset to handle visibility of the content inside.
